response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS grp_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), o AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(g.grp_avg) AS mean_of_timing_avgs, AVG(g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_average FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.grp_avg > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: 'Average' as the benchmark means the overall mean institutional ownership across all rows with non-missing instownpct, not the mean of the per-timing averages.
Rows with a NULL eventannotm form one group. GROUP BY puts NULLs together. A timing whose ownership values are all NULL has a NULL average and is excluded.
'How far above average' is the difference group average minus the benchmark, averaged across the qualifying timings, with no rounding.

alternatives.interpretation: The benchmark is the mean of the per-timing average ownerships (each timing weighted equally), not the row-level overall mean.
alternatives.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS grp_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm HAVING AVG(instownpct) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.grp_avg) AS mean_of_timing_avgs, AVG(g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_average FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.grp_avg > o.overall_avg
